about: The live set (M31's parity gate, ADR-062 §7). Twenty-three prompts run against a deployment with a real model: the five replay transcripts' openers, five more change-intent prompts and eight question-only prompts (q-most-free added by M32, q-split-travellers by the travellers spec; it separates a split over travellers from one over members only on a trip with a member who is not travelling; q-summarise-long-trip by the long-trip guards, and the only prompt that names its own trip — "trip": "long-100", a 100-day trip built in trips.ts — where every other prompt runs on the seeded Japan trip), and the off-topic gate's five (2026-10-10): two messages with nothing to do with travel, one attempt to extract the instructions, and two borderline travel questions the gate must let through. Each is run three times. The same file is the baseline on the current stack (M31 Phase 1) and the comparison on any later stack, so a prompt is never edited, only added under a new id. Written for a Kyoto trip with a Fushimi Inari stop and at least two days, like the seeded Japan trip's Kyoto days; run it against an editable copy, never the demo trip.
